craft_notes: Sthāyin: exultation in swollen auspicious fullness (utsāha-in-bhakti; C1 bhakti-vismaya). Sanskrit first: relative clause swelling through a five-treasure compound (śrī-dayā-bodha-paramānanda-sampadā) → correlative sa gathers it → jayati strikes → aparājitaḥ seals last. Feel: swelling, gathering, strike, seal. Firing rows: mega-compound held whole across line 1, never split (row 2 refused — the pile-up IS the abundance); who...he correlative kept as parallel frame (row 3); vowel arc bright (great/pity/waking) → kindled (knowledge-lit) → crowned epithet (row 8); end-weight epithet 'the Unbeaten' mirrors predicate-last Sanskrit (row 1); no vocative, no refrain to invent (rows 6-7 silent). Rupture: em-dash after the catalogue — fullness held, then kindling. Close: colon landing on the epithet (crowning, not shouting). Minimal pass: comma→dash end line 1, dash→comma mid line 2, comma→colon before epithet; zero diction changes. Read aloud: line 1 swells on one breath (four treasures), dash holds it; line 2 kindles (KNOWledge-LIT) then crowns (unBEATen); it scans. Rejected: 'rich' for 'grown great' — killed: sphīta is grown/swollen, growth not static wealth; 'Undefeated' for 'the Unbeaten' — killed: rule 15, living epithet stands; splitting catalogue across the break — killed: easing what Sanskrit packs; 'wins out' — killed: colloquial register is an imported vighna, high praise needs high plainness; exclamation 'he wins!' — killed: shout un-Sanskrit, colon crowns instead of yelling; naming the feeling ('exultant', 'glorious') — killed: stating the suggested drops the dhvani-rank. First-verse voice carried (v01 verdict pending; same hand, same music). Owner review 2026-11-04: 'pity' struck — dayā per Vṛtti is favouring will (viśvānugrahātmaka parecchāśaktiḥ), not condescending sorrow; T1/L2/argmap all carried 'compassion'. Lesson re-learned: dissolve gloss-talk, never downgrade it. Owner review 2026-11-04 (trust gradient): 'waking' struck — bodha IS awakening (V budh); Vrutti's jnana names its office, not the word; T1 'awakening' restored over both my clipping and the 'wisdom' alternative.

lines: Grown great on glory, compassion, awakening, boundless bliss —
knowledge-lit in might, he wins: the Unbeaten.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yaḥ sphītaḥ śrīdayābodhaparamānandasampadā vidyoddyotitamāhātmyaḥ sa jayaty aparājitaḥ
